Name: Hermes
Summary: Hermes was a Christian in Rome greeted by Paul alongside Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermas, and Patrobas.
KeyStory: Hermes was a Christian in Rome greeted by Paul alongside Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermas, and Patrobas.
LifeLesson: A name in Paul's greeting shows a life joined to the gospel community.
